definitions.explanation: Suffix attaching to nouns to form the name of a formal written document, certificate, or record. Common in business, legal, and administrative vocabulary.

examples.japanese: {報告|ほうこく}{書|しょ}を{書|か}いた。
{契約|けいやく}{書|しょ}に{署名|しょめい}してください。
{申請|しんせい}{書|しょ}に{必要|ひつよう}{事項|じこう}をすべて{記入|きにゅう}した。
examples.english: I filled in all the required items on the application form.

notes:
Forms the name of a specific kind of document. Highly productive in business, legal, and bureaucratic contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- {報告|ほうこく}{書|しょ}: report
- {契約|けいやく}{書|しょ}: contract
- {申請|しんせい}{書|しょ}: application form
- {依頼|いらい}{書|しょ}: written request
- {証明|しょうめい}{書|しょ}: certificate
- {請求|せいきゅう}{書|しょ}: invoice; bill
- {計画|けいかく}{書|しょ}: written plan; proposal

SIMILAR SUFFIXES:
- 〜{状|じょう}: letter, written notice — often for invitations and notifications ({招待|しょうたい}{状|じょう})
- 〜{票|ひょう}: slip, form — for small slips like {投票|とうひょう} (vote) or {伝票|でんぴょう} (chit)
